property_summary: For every admissible input, whenever the pseudorandom draw uint(keccak256(timestamp,difficulty,player))%2==0 the contract must pay out and reset pot to 0; the mutant (modulo 3) leaves pot at 10 for draws that are even but not divisible by 3, breaking this rule.
change_summary: Replace the random value computation modulo `% 2` with `% 3`, changing the win probability and therefore which calls reset the pot.
